publication.title: A Survey on Benchmarks of LLM-based GUI Agents

name: A Survey on Benchmarks of LLM-based GUI Agents
notes: A TechRxiv preprint (version 1, 16 December 2025) that has not been peer reviewed. The full text tabulates grounding and QA benchmarks such as ScreenQA, ScreenSpot-Pro and OSWorld-G, navigation benchmarks such as VisualWebArena, AndroidControl and GUI-Odyssey, and open-world benchmarks such as SPA-Bench, macOSWorld and MMBench-GUI, with each benchmark's dataset, environment type, evaluators and venue. It reprints ScreenSpot-Pro and OSWorld leaderboard results and GUI-Odyssey results collected from earlier papers, and names explainability, generalization, security, user-centric tasks and on-device deployment as open challenges. Crossref and the preprint state a CC BY 4.0 license.
summary: Surveys LLM-based GUI agent benchmarks in three task tiers (grounding and QA, multi-step navigation, open-world environments), comparing their datasets, environments and metrics, and outlines open evaluation gaps.
